title: vertical-v2 local receipt
description: local-receipt.json, written by record-local alone when the local review completes, closed at every level (references/vertical-contract.md sections 3.5 and 3.6; the E15 lane contract A4, class (b)). It fixes what the local verdict rests on: each local call this run requested, with the sha256 of the sidecar and the capture readers wrote for it, and the sha256 of local.json. request --outside releases nothing unless the receipt validates, names exactly this run's requested local calls, and every hash in it still matches the file on disk.

receipt_version.description: the version of this receipt shape

run_id.description: the run the local review belongs to

calls.description: every local call this run requested, in request order (a re-send after its first call)

sidecar_sha256.description: sha256 of <run dir>/readers/<call id>/sidecar.json as readers wrote it

capture_sha256.description: sha256 of <run dir>/readers/<call id>/raw.md, or null when the call has no capture

local_sha256.description: sha256 of local.json as record-local wrote it

at.description: UTC instant record-local wrote the receipt
